$comment: Mission 1.66.2. The verdict, and what twelve first-party documents did and did not settle.
mission: 1.66.2 — ONYPHE Public Documentation Reconciliation & Configuration-Metadata Closure V1
primary_outcome_statement: Twelve first-party ONYPHE documents were retrieved and re-read verbatim against the three residual questions. The package is narrowed and better grounded, one genuinely new configuration fact was established, and a published support channel was found and cited rather than inferred. No load-bearing gate moved: B2 stays PARTIAL because no page addresses the repeated-observation case, TCP/22 datascan membership stays unpublished, and the three post-30-day retention fields stay UNKNOWN. ONYPHE remains INDIVIDUALLY_UNRESOLVED, qualified apparatuses remain 0 of 4, and nothing was executed, sent or registered.
this_is_a_valid_successful_mission: §49 C says so directly. The mission's job was to find out whether the public documentation closes the residuals. It does not, and establishing that is the result.

why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_A: Outcome A needs all three residual areas at mandatory PASS. None reached it.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_B: B needs at least one previously unresolved LOAD-BEARING question definitively closed. The closest candidate is configuration mutability, which moved from unknown to established -- and establishing that a configuration CHANGES moves no gate toward PASS. It makes the time-addressability question more necessary, not less. Reporting B would let that read as progress toward qualification when it is the opposite.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_D: D is for the temporal-object case being conclusively resolved. It was not, and the page most likely to resolve it was fetched and does not.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_E: The User API finding is real and is reported as a secondary outcome. It is not the principal result: the mission asked whether public documentation closes the residuals, and the User API is one route among several that does not.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_F: Nothing contradicts the current package. The 2024 retrospective and the current refresh page name different scanner regions and different port counts, and they describe different moments. That is drift, not contradiction, and reading it as contradiction would be the error.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_G_H_I: PR #110 is merged at 61fb5fb, every canonical counter matched the expected baseline exactly, and no canonical row was created, modified or deleted.
why_this_outcome_and_not_another.why_not_J: Nothing blocked the mission. The full budget was available and used, and the pages answered the questions they answer.

what_this_mission_actually_established.$comment: Four things, and only two of them are new facts about the world.

1_a_new_configuration_fact.finding: The datascan port set is region-dependent: 500 ports from US/FR, the TOP 25 from SG/CN.
1_a_new_configuration_fact.consequence: One apparatus applies at least two configurations to different parts of its own population, so a single count drawn from it could mix populations selected under different rules.

2_a_previously_unknown_answer.finding: The datascan configuration has demonstrably changed: port counts, cadence, scanner regions and category coverage all moved, published by the provider with numbers.
2_a_previously_unknown_answer.consequence: APPARATUS_CONFIGURATION_MUST_BE_TIME_ADDRESSABLE is demonstrated rather than anticipated, and the current 500-port figure is a snapshot rather than a constant.

3_a_channel_established.finding: A support address is published on the official blog beside an instruction to send questions there.
3_a_channel_established.status: NEW, first-party, cited rather than inferred
3_a_channel_established.consequence: Future contact routing, and nothing operational now.

4_a_negative_that_is_worth_the_budget.finding: The repeated-observation storage semantics are not published, after a directed search of the four pages most likely to carry them.
4_a_negative_that_is_worth_the_budget.status: an absence, established rather than assumed
4_a_negative_that_is_worth_the_budget.consequence: It converts we have not found it into we looked where it would be and it is not there, which is what makes the sent enquiry worth having sent.

the_reusable_observation.$comment: What a later mission should carry away.
the_reusable_observation.statement: A documentation budget spent and returning no gate change is not a failed budget. What it buys is the difference between an unanswered question and an unpublished answer.
the_reusable_observation.why_that_difference_is_operational: An unanswered question might be closed by reading more. An unpublished answer can only be closed by asking, by measuring, or by choosing a different apparatus. Knowing which of those you face decides the next mission, and this mission decides it: for ONYPHE, further public reading is exhausted.
the_reusable_observation.the_earlier_instance: Mission 1.63 spent four named reads and changed zero topics, and recorded that knowing which page to read is not progress. This is the same shape one step further on: the pages have now been read.

boundaries_held.$comment: Every prohibition in the brief, as a measured fact rather than a promise.

next_mission_recommendation.$comment: §52. Outcome C routes to 1.67, and the ONYPHE enquiry stays live in parallel.
next_mission_recommendation.name: Mission 1.67 — Second Qualified Scanner Discovery V1
next_mission_recommendation.why_now: Further public reading about the researched candidate is exhausted, and the other three already have complete packages with documented failures. What is missing is a fifth candidate, not a fifth document.
it_should_carry_forward: the offered requirement APPARATUS_CONFIGURATION_MUST_BE_UNIFORM_ACROSS_THE_FRAME, to adopt or decline on its own evidence
the practice of applying gates BEFORE choosing, which Mission 1.60 established
RELIABILITY_REVIEWABILITY as a first-class search criterion, checked before an apparatus is treated as a candidate
it_must_not: wait for the ONYPHE reply, which is outstanding and runs in parallel
execute the ONYPHE User API, which §52 excludes from Mission 1.67 explicitly
treat ONYPHE as qualified, or as disqualified
next_mission_recommendation.the_parallel_track: The ONYPHE enquiry is sent and unanswered. If a reply arrives it is frozen verbatim first and reviewed in its own mission, and that review is the only thing that can move B2, the port set or the retention fields.
next_mission_recommendation.netlas_remains_independent: One address, readable in a browser, completes its envelope and gets its own approval string. It does not wait for ONYPHE.

stop_condition.awaiting: operator review, a provider reply, and one address for Netlas
